Basic, Expanded, Ultimate and Creative containers share rarity colors with reservoirs and emitters. Finite capacities commonly hold 100K, 1M and 10M; trust the readings on your jars.$(br2)Empty, partial and full are states of one item. They never recharge themselves. Hold a wand to see inventory mana and focus.
Only the full infinite variant exists. Extraction never depletes it, and it accepts no mana. Carry it in your inventory or offhand to supply unlimited wand mana. It does not remove focus costs.
